args.lesson: File-specific licensing correction resolves the observed blanket-MIT defect without changing executable bytes. Independent clean-directory execution and hash/reversal checks passed. Initial verification incorrectly mixed the llms diff into homepage additions and retained an extra README separator newline; correcting those harness assumptions reproduced historical hashes. Next time scope diff checks by file and preserve original trailing-newline semantics. Approval establishes release readiness only, not downloads, customer delivery, demand or revenue.

description: Independent checks now reproduce the corrected SQLite release digest and pass 10 checks, including clean-directory execution, expected results, finalization, licensing and reversal to prior content. This supports a release handoff. Feedback remains 0 classified / 3 unclassified: demand is unknown, and no funding or revenue is verified.
